messages:
maya: Heads up — after the canary deploy of quantized-v2 (8-bit mixed) we’re seeing a ~6.5% drop in EM on the golden promptset C vs baseline float32. Notified because this looks like a quality blip, could be tokenization/kv-cache edgecase. Can we triage quickly? cc @priya @sam
priya: Oof. Do you have the failing examples or a diff? If it’s localized we can pull a small relabel batch and run through the eval harness.
sam: If it’s 6.5% on EM, we should stratify by prompt length + role-type. Short QA prompts often regress with quantization. I can generate stratified sample ids.
maya: Attached a quick dump of 50 examples that flipped from pass->fail. Most are short clarification Qs and a few math microsteps. Link: https://redwood.internal/s/qa/quick-dump-1738201234
ciara: Can we avoid a full golden refresh? prefer a targeted spot-check first: 200 stratified examples (50 short QA, 50 multi-step, 50 instruction, 50 edgecases). Labelers can relabel with a gold rubric.
priya: Agreed. I’ll create a relabel job in LabelQueue, priority high. Job config: {schema: "gold-v2", overlaps: 3, reviewers: 2} — can we keep overlap=3 for stronger signal?
sam: overlap=2 usually ok for quick triage but overlap=3 reduces noise. For 200 examples overlap=3 is still quick. I’ll produce sampling SQL and the eval run command.
maya: Perfect. Also need to repro locally — can anyone run the model with the same tokenizer/kv settings? I suspect a mismatch between tokenization fallback in the quant runtime.
priya: I ran a quick batch of 100 locally vs float32. The EM delta is 0.06 for that small set, matches canary direction. I pushed a few example ids to the relabel job notes.
ciara: Labeling ETA? I can ping ops to get two labelers on it, target turnaround <24h.
sam: Sampling SQL (quick):
```sql
SELECT id FROM prompt_bank
WHERE promptset='golden_C'
AND blocked=false
ORDER BY CASE WHEN length(prompt)<50 THEN 0 WHEN length(prompt)<200 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, random()
LIMIT 200;
```
Run eval locally:
```bash
# quantized-v2 container image: registry/redwood/quantized-v2:sha-abc123
curl -s -X POST https://localhost:8080/v1/eval -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEV_KEY' -d '{"model":"quantized-v2","inputs_file":"/tmp/sample_ids.json","batch_size":8}' | jq .summary
```
maya: Nice. After relabels are in, let’s run the eval harness and compare: baseline float32 vs quantized-v2. If EM regression >3% and F1 drop >4% then we block rollout and rollback canary.
priya: I’ll wire the relabel job to auto-upload to the eval harness when overlap consensus reached. Also adding a small automated sanity check for tokenization mismatches (token counts diff >10%).
ciara: Heads-up to SRE: can we tag canary traffic as "hold" until triage completes? @deploy-bot can you add the hold label?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary flag for quantized-v2 set to "hold" by request from ciara — timestamp 1738201450
maya: Thanks. One more ask — please snapshot the model config (tokenizer version, kv_cache: enabled, kernel flags) and attach to the thread so we can correlate.
sam: Done, pushed config gist: https://internal-gists/gh/1738201234/config and added the kernel logs (small) — look for warnings about "kv-cache-compat"
priya: Relabel job created: LQ-9876. Overlap=3, reviewers 2. ETA 18h based on current load. I’ll update thread when consensus ready.
ciara: I’ll schedule a 30m quick sync tomorrow 10:30am to review results and decide rollback. If relabel consensus already flags systemic regression we rollback immediately.
maya: Thanks team. Action items: sam -> sampling + local eval, priya -> relabel job + auto-upload, ciara -> labeler ops + deploy hold, maya -> aggregate results & decide rollback.
priya: quick note: if relabel shows high reviewer disagreement (>20%) we should expand sample to 500 to reduce variance.
maya: Agreed. Will keep flexibility.
priya: adding :white_check_mark: when LQ-9876 finishes.
ciara: :eyes:
